prompt: Build a 3x2 GridLayout form: complete buildForm so the panel lays out Name/Email/Age labels in the left column and their matching named text fields in the right column, added in row order.
explanation: GridLayout divides the container into equal cells and fills them in the order components are added: left to right, then top to bottom. With 3 rows and 2 columns, adding label, field, label, field, label, field produces the classic two-column form. The layout manager is set with setLayout(new GridLayout(3, 2)) -- replacing the JPanel default FlowLayout -- and the add order alone determines which cell each component lands in.
hints: Call setLayout(new GridLayout(3, 2)) first -- a JPanel uses FlowLayout by default.
GridLayout has no add-position argument: cells fill in the exact order you call add(...).
Add label then field for each row: nameLabel, nameField, emailLabel, emailField, ageLabel, ageField.
